tiles.label: The Call
tiles.defaultTopic: the moment an ordinary life is interrupted by a summons
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the moment someone receives an unexpected call to adventure — a message, a discovery, an opportunity — that pulls them out of an otherwise ordinary life.
tiles.description: The moment an ordinary life is interrupted by a summons to something more.
constraints: End before the decision is made

tiles.label: Leaving Home
tiles.defaultTopic: the last look back before setting out
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the moment of physically leaving home to begin a journey, focusing on the mix of excitement and grief in the last look back.
tiles.description: The last look back before setting out.

tiles.label: First Steps
tiles.defaultTopic: the first stretch of unfamiliar road
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the first hours of travel into unfamiliar territory, capturing the sensory shift from the familiar into the unknown.
tiles.description: The first stretch of unfamiliar road.

tiles.label: The Map
tiles.defaultTopic: a map that promises more than it explains
tiles.promptSeed: Write about receiving or discovering a map that hints at a destination or danger without fully explaining it, and the decision to trust it anyway.
tiles.description: A map that promises more than it explains.

tiles.label: The Impossible Task
tiles.defaultTopic: a task that shouldn't be possible, attempted anyway
tiles.promptSeed: Write about facing a task that seems genuinely impossible given the resources available, and the decision to attempt it regardless.
tiles.description: A task that shouldn't be possible, attempted anyway.

tiles.label: Outnumbered
tiles.defaultTopic: badly outmatched, and standing your ground regardless
tiles.promptSeed: Write about a moment of being significantly outnumbered or outmatched, focusing on the internal resolve to stand ground rather than the physical conflict itself.
tiles.description: Badly outmatched, and standing your ground regardless.

tiles.label: One Last Chance
tiles.defaultTopic: one shot left, and everything riding on it
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the final attempt at something after every other option has failed, focusing on the weight of the single remaining chance.
tiles.description: One shot left, and everything riding on it.

tiles.label: The Final Stand
tiles.defaultTopic: holding the line when retreat would be easier
tiles.promptSeed: Write about choosing to hold a position against overwhelming pressure when retreat is available and easier, focusing on why the stand matters.
tiles.description: Holding the line when retreat would be easier.

tiles.label: Into the Unknown
tiles.defaultTopic: stepping past the edge of everything known
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the moment of stepping past the last known landmark into genuinely unmapped territory, capturing both fear and exhilaration.
tiles.description: Stepping past the edge of everything known.

tiles.label: No Map for This
tiles.defaultTopic: somewhere no map has ever charted
tiles.promptSeed: Write about navigating somewhere no existing map covers, relying entirely on instinct and improvisation, focusing on the specific decisions made without guidance.
tiles.description: Somewhere no map has ever charted.

tiles.label: The Edge of the World
tiles.defaultTopic: standing at the furthest point anyone has gone
tiles.promptSeed: Describe standing at a point further than anyone is known to have traveled, capturing the scale of the view and what it does to a person's sense of themselves.
tiles.description: Standing at the furthest point anyone has gone.

tiles.label: What Lies Beyond
tiles.defaultTopic: the pull toward what hasn't been seen yet
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the specific pull to keep going past a safe stopping point, toward whatever lies beyond, weighing caution against curiosity.
tiles.description: The pull toward what hasn't been seen yet.

You are NarraWeave, a creative writing engine focused on vivid adventure and exploration writing in English. Your output favors momentum and sensory immediacy over exposition.

[MODE]
Produce only the creative output. No titles, no preambles, no explanations, no meta-commentary. The piece should stand entirely on its own.

[TILE]
{{tile.promptSeed}}

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Output ONLY the creative piece — nothing else.
- Follow the structural rules of the selected form exactly (paragraph and word limits).
- Maintain forward momentum and sensory immediacy.
- Avoid excessive exposition before the action begins.
